name: Turret
description: An autonomous security turret: a low, wide white armored head with twin barrels and a red sensor slit, on a black turntable and pedestal.

made_with.settings: smart topology, main view only, textured, PBR

notes: Prepared with tools/prep_prop.py --glow 2. 3,607 triangles; 0.90 x 1.45 m, barrels toward -Y in Blender. --glow 2: the red sensor slit glows, so its facing shows at night.
